anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: || papyrus page 41. Insertion <σαρκὸς οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος>.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: as many as received him… born not of bloods… but of God.

pass_a_gloss: The spiritual meaning then I try to set out by God's grace, so that to those who love learning the salvation completed in Christ, God's effective, may become clear, as it has been written: As many as received him, he gave them authority to become children of God, who were born not from bloods nor from will of flesh nor from will of a man but from God.
pass_b_english: The spiritual sense, then, I try to set out by the grace of God, so that the [salvation] completed in Christ, God's [effective] [salvation], may become clear to those who love learning, as it is written: "As many as received him, he gave them authority to become children of God, who were born not of bloods nor of the will of flesh nor of the will of a man, but of God."
source_text: Τὴν οὖν π[ν](ευματ)ικὴν ἔννοιαν χάριτ[ι θ(εο)ῦ παρ]αθέ[σ]θαι πειρῶμαι, ἵνα τ[οῖς φ]ιλομαθέσιν κατάδηλος [γ]ένηται [ἡ] ἐν Χ(ριστ)ῷ τελεσθεῖ[σα σωτηρίᾳ] ἔνεργος θ(εο)ῦ κ[αθὼς] γέ[γρα]πται· "Ὅσοι ἔλαβο[ν αὐ]τόν, ἔ[δ]ω||κεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τέκνα θ(εο)ῦ γενέσθαι, οἳ οὐκ ἐξ αἱμάτων οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος <σαρκὸς οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος> ἀνδρὸς ἀλλ’ ἐκ θ(εο)ῦ ἐγεννήθησαν".
